anchors.statement: With atm-core's PORT-010 exclusions removed, PORT-010 must report zero false alarms on atm-core.
anchors.quote: atm-core can remove its PORT-010 exclusions and get zero false alarms, while real Windows gaps are still reported.
anchors.scope: The item changes PORT-010 in crates/sc-lint-portability, its fixtures or docs, or atm-core PORT-010 exclusions.

anchors.statement: PORT-010 must still report a real Windows gap: a cfg(unix) item with no Windows counterpart.
anchors.quote: atm-core can remove its PORT-010 exclusions and get zero false alarms, while real Windows gaps are still reported.
anchors.scope: The item changes PORT-010 exemptions, classification or suppression in crates/sc-lint-portability.

anchors.statement: sc-lint must run atm-core's setup step itself, so atm-core needs no Justfile glue to run it.
anchors.quote: atm-core can delete its Justfile glue (_py, sc_lint_clippy_prefix, _sc-lint-clippy) because sc-lint runs the setup step and uses the right Python itself.
anchors.scope: The item changes sc-lint setup/provisioning, consumer config ([tool.sc-lint].setup), or the just setup flow.

anchors.statement: sc-lint must choose the right Python interpreter for atm-core's steps itself, so atm-core can delete _py, sc_lint_clippy_prefix and _sc-lint-clippy.
anchors.quote: atm-core can delete its Justfile glue (_py, sc_lint_clippy_prefix, _sc-lint-clippy) because sc-lint runs the setup step and uses the right Python itself.
anchors.scope: The item changes interpreter selection, runner config ([tool.sc-lint].runner), step argv or step environment in crates/sc-lint.

anchors.statement: sc-lint must be able to enforce dependency ownership on source files only.
anchors.quote: sc-lint enforces dependency ownership on source files only, and we know which of atm-core's three boundary settings it already covers.
anchors.scope: The item changes global_dependency_ownership or SCB-MANIFEST-004 in crates/sc-lint-boundary, or their config keys.

anchors.statement: Phase M must record which of atm-core's three boundary settings sc-lint already covers.
anchors.quote: sc-lint enforces dependency ownership on source files only, and we know which of atm-core's three boundary settings it already covers.
anchors.scope: The item audits atm-core [boundaries] settings against sc-lint-boundary or writes a parity table.

anchors.statement: PORT-010 must report none of the 47 findings listed for the 18 atm-core paths in sc-lint#786, because none is a true positive.
anchors.quote:
Result: **no TRUE POSITIVE found**. All 18 paths have a Windows (or portable) counterpart, or are unix-only by design.
The 47 findings at this head match the issue's list exactly (same files, lines, item names)
anchors.scope: The item changes PORT-010 classification in crates/sc-lint-portability or its #786 fixtures.

anchors.statement: PORT-010 must not report a cfg(unix) item that has a same-name #[cfg(not(unix))] sibling in the same scope, whether that scope is a module, an inherent impl, or the crate root.
anchors.quote: S3  cfg(unix) item with a same-name `#[cfg(not(unix))]` sibling in the same scope (module, inherent impl, or crate root). Rows 2, 4, 6, 14, 18. This is #720 generalized beyond crate-root main.rs.
anchors.scope: The item changes PORT-010 sibling detection or port010 fixtures (crate_root_main, module, inherent impl).

anchors.statement: Consumer config must accept setup.pre, an argv that just setup runs before sc-lint provisioning.
anchors.quote: Proposal: `setup.pre` (argv run by `just setup` before sc-lint provisioning)
anchors.scope: The item edits ScLintConfigFile or consumer config parsing, or the just setup / installer flow.

anchors.statement: When runner.python names a venv, a leading python in any lint or test step argv must resolve to that venv's interpreter on every OS.
anchors.quote: (1) a leading `"python"` in any lint **or test** step argv resolves to that venv's interpreter on every OS
anchors.scope: The item changes step argv construction or runner.python handling in crates/sc-lint.

anchors.statement: When runner.python names a venv, sc-lint must prepend that venv's bin directory (Scripts on Windows) to each step child's PATH.
anchors.quote: (2) the venv's bin/Scripts dir is prepended to the child's PATH (our `python_cmd` does this today so helpers that spawn `python` stay pinned)
anchors.scope: The item changes step child environment or runner.python handling in crates/sc-lint.

anchors.statement: sc-lint must run sc_lint.* wheel helper steps on the kit interpreter and must never apply runner.python to them.
anchors.quote: plain `python` steps use `runner.python`; `sc_lint.*` wheel helpers always use the kit interpreter and `runner.python` must never apply to them.
anchors.scope: The item adds or changes how sc_lint.* helper steps (deny, manifests, shear, spell) are run in crates/sc-lint.

anchors.statement: sc-lint must let a consumer export the runner.python interpreter as PYO3_PYTHON to steps that are not Python steps, such as cargo clippy.
anchors.quote: We need one more knob, e.g. `runner.export_env = ["PYO3_PYTHON"]` (plus the PATH prepend in (2) applied to every step), or a per-step `env`.
anchors.scope: The item changes step environment, runner config, or clippy steps in crates/sc-lint.

anchors.statement: global_dependency_ownership must offer a config setting that limits the ownership check to src/**/*.rs and excludes integration-test targets.
anchors.quote: The previous atm-core checker passes on this tree because it scans `src/**/*.rs` and does not treat separate integration-test targets as production source. There is no config setting to preserve that source-only scope.
anchors.scope: The item changes global_dependency_ownership or SCB-MANIFEST-004 config in crates/sc-lint-boundary.

anchors.statement: Phase M must check each of the three atm-core [boundaries] keys against released sc-lint-boundary and file a config-surface gap issue for each key not covered.
anchors.quote: Verify which of the three atm-core keys are covered and file the remainder as config-surface gaps.
anchors.scope: The item audits atm-core [boundaries] keys or files sc-lint-boundary config-surface gap issues.
